{{Top|leg}}
'''TrangTwo lowlight optical bands''' were parts sometimes used to replace [[Photoreceptor/Legends|Photoreceptors]] in [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to reduce lighting expenses in low light areas. The droids in the [[Level 2012 Physical Plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had this modification.<ref name="A Forest Apart">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref>
